name: Finn's Dockside
short_description: Recommended by our Tampa local Keisha Abelgas, Finn’s Dockside is Apollo Beach’s exciting new bar and grill, offering a distinctive waterside dining experience. This charming spot specializes in delicious seafood-focused dishes, from fresh oysters and shrimp to expertly prepared fish. The menu is complemented by a selection of craft cocktails, designed to perfectly pair with your meal while you enjoy stunning waterfront views. Finn’s Dockside is not just about great food—it’s about creating memorable moments with friendly, attentive service in a relaxed, inviting atmosphere. Whether you're looking for a casual meal with friends or a special outing by the water, Finn’s Dockside provides the perfect setting for a truly enjoyable experience.
title: Finn's Dockside

name: Painting with a Twist
short_description: Dive into a world of fun and creativity with Painting with a Twist, highly recommended by Tampa local Erica G. Untaran. This vibrant studio invites you to connect with friends over a glass of wine and your favorite snacks while enjoying a night full of laughter. No creative or artistic skills are needed—just bring your enthusiasm! With step-by-step guidance from talented instructors, you'll create your very own masterpiece. Perfect for date nights, girls' nights out, or any social gathering, Painting with a Twist ensures a memorable and entertaining experience for everyone. Unleash your inner artist and enjoy an evening of painting, sipping, and socializing!
title: Painting with a Twist

name: Amalie Arena
short_description: Recommended by Tampa locals Travis and Ashley Jennings and Greg Wolf, AMALIE Arena stands out as Florida’s premier entertainment venue and the proud home of the three-time Stanley Cup champions, the Tampa Bay Lightning. Unlike other venues, AMALIE Arena boasts unique features such as lightning-throwing Tesla coils and an expansive 11,000-square-foot Budweiser Biergarten with stunning city views. Recently renovated, this arena consistently ranks among the top venues in the United States, offering an unparalleled experience for sports fans and concert-goers alike. Whether you're cheering on the Lightning or enjoying a world-class concert, AMALIE Arena promises a memorable visit every time.
title: Amalie Arena

name: CW's Gin Joint
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa locals Davy Rolando, Rachel Almanza, and Erica G. Untaran, CW’s Gin Joint offers a stylish, relaxed atmosphere where fine spirits are savored without pretentiousness. Our downtown Tampa space, designed by proprietor Carolyn Wilson (CW), mirrors this elegant yet casual vibe.

Enjoy our expertly crafted menu, perfectly paired with notable and obscure liquors. Whether CW’s Gin Joint is your first stop or your sole destination, each visit promises the joy and comfort of savoring something rare. Make a reservation today.
title: CW's Gin Joint

name: Sur La Table
short_description: Elevate your culinary skills with Sur La Table, a favorite of Tampa locals Greg Wolf, Keisha Abelgas, and Erica Untaran. Whether you're aiming to become a better home chef or pursuing grander culinary dreams, Sur La Table provides expert instruction and flexible class options to suit your needs. From mastering essential kitchen techniques to crafting Michelin-star-worthy dishes, there's a class for every interest and skill level. Enjoy in-store lessons, online cooking classes, or even host a private class for a fun group activity or date night. Sur La Table also offers specialized classes for couples and kids, making it the perfect destination for anyone passionate about cooking
title: Sur La Table

name: Get Up and Go Kayaking
short_description: Experience the water like never before with Get Up and Go Kayaking, a top recommendation from Tampa locals Jenn Richardson and Erica G. Untaran. Glide through stunning waterways in completely clear kayaks, guided by a team of top-notch experts. They pride themselves on delivering unforgettable adventures, ensuring each guest enjoys a unique and memorable experience. Whether you're exploring serene lakes or vibrant coastal areas, Get Up and Go Kayaking offers a one-of-a-kind adventure you won’t want to miss.
title: Get Up and Go Kayaking

name: Haiku
short_description: Recommended by Tampa locals Travis and Ashley Jennings, Jenn Richardson, and Erica G. Untaran, Haiku is a standout Asian Fusion restaurant that offers Izakaya-style dishes infused with diverse Asian influences. Enjoy a memorable dining experience with a creative beverage menu featuring sakes, sangrias, and hand-crafted cocktails. Make a reservation to savor the innovative flavors and vibrant atmosphere at Haiku.
title: Haiku

name: Nabruzzi Trattoria
short_description: Recommended by Tampa local Davontay Robinson & Erica Untaran, Nabruzzi Trattoria has been bringing Napoli and Abruzzo-infused Italian cuisine to the heart of Lutz since 2014. Founded by a true Italian chef who started his culinary journey in Italy and honed his skills in New York, Nabruzzi Trattoria offers great food and exceptional menu selections always cooked to order. With an extensive wine list and friendly, professional service, it's the perfect place for a romantic dinner, business meeting, special family celebration, or a fun gathering with friends and family. Come meet the charming owners and our hospitable staff for an unforgettable "la dolce vita" dining experience. Make a reservation today.
title: Nabruzzi Trattoria

name: Bella's Italian Café
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa locals Travis and Ashley Jennings and Meredith, Bella’s Italian Café has been a beloved institution since 1986. Founded by Bill Shumate and Joanie Corneil with a vision to bring authentic Italian cuisine to Tampa, Bella’s has grown to become one of the longest-standing and most popular establishments in the area.

For over 30 years, Bella’s has delighted diners with its genuine Italian dishes, offering a menu filled with traditional favorites crafted with passion and the finest ingredients. Whether you're a longtime fan or a first-time visitor, Bella’s Italian Café promises a memorable dining experience that captures the heart of Italy right here in Tampa.
title: Bella's Italian Café

name: Osteria
short_description: Recommended by Tampa locals Brandon Mack and Meredith, Osteria Natalina has been a cherished culinary destination in the Tampa Bay area since 2000. Founded with the mission to bring authentic Italian flavors to Florida, the restaurant proudly serves dishes made from "Mama Natalina's" secret recipes, lovingly transported from Rimini. Specializing in exquisite seafood, Osteria Natalina also caters to off-menu requests, ensuring every guest leaves satisfied. The dining experience is further elevated by a carefully curated selection of Italian wines, imported directly from renowned Italian wineries, providing the perfect "Vino E Cucina" experience. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or enjoying a casual night out, Osteria Natalina promises a true taste of Italy in the heart of Tampa.
title: Osteria

name: Malio's
short_description: Recommended by Tampa local Davy Rolando, Malio's Prime Steakhouse carries forward the legacy of the original Malio's Steakhouse, established in 1969 by Malio Iavarone. With roots tracing back to his parents' restaurant in 1945, Malio's has built a reputation for delivering an exceptional dining experience over the past 35 years. Upholding this tradition, Malio's Prime Steakhouse serves USDA Prime Beef and the freshest seafood, including coldwater lobster tails. Accompanied by a selection of over 200 wines, Malio's offers unparalleled service and ambiance.
title: Malio's Prime Steakhouse

name: Olivia
short_description: Olivia is a must-visit spot in Tampa, highly recommended by locals Meredith and Erica G. Untaran. This modern Italian restaurant captures the essence of a traditional trattoria while adding a creative, chef-inspired twist to its menu. OLIVIA blends casual sophistication with an inviting atmosphere, making it perfect for both regular diners and those seeking a relaxed evening with friends over craft cocktails. Enjoy a culinary journey through authentic Italian flavors, elevated with contemporary flair, all in a setting that combines comfort with style. Whether you’re here for a casual meal or a special night out, OLIVIA delivers a memorable dining experience.
title: Olivia

name: Bern's
short_description: Discover the epitome of fine dining at Bern’s Steak House, a gem in Tampa’s culinary scene. Esteemed by locals such as Travis and Ashley Jennings, Davontay Robinson, DJ Bonoan, Erica G. Untaran, and Keisha Abelgas, Bern's offers more than just a meal—it’s a journey. Since 1956, guests have been captivated by its vast wine collection, one of the largest globally, and its renowned dessert room. Savor prime steaks, meticulously cut to order, and relish farm-fresh vegetables sourced directly from Bern’s own farm or the finest purveyors. At Bern’s, every visit transcends dining, turning your evening into a memorable culinary adventure.
title: Bern's Steakhouse

name: Columbia Restaurant
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Travis and Ashley Jennings, Davy Rolando, DJ Bonoan, Erica G. Untaran, and Keisha Abelgas

Founded in 1905 by Cuban immigrant Casimiro Hernandez, Sr., the Columbia Restaurant is Florida’s oldest restaurant℠, and the largest Spanish restaurant in the world.

The Columbia Restaurant was founded in 1905 and is Florida’s oldest restaurant℠. Locations include the flagship restaurant in Tampa’s Historic Ybor City, additional locations include St. Armands Circle in Sarasota, the Historic District in St. Augustine, Sand Key on Clearwater Beach, Central Florida's town of Celebration, the Columbia Cafe on the Riverwalk in Tampa and the Columbia Restaurant Cafe at Tampa International Airport.

Make a reservation
title: Columbia Restaurant

name: Forbici Modern Italian
short_description: Recommended by Tampa Locals Jenn Richardson and Erica G. Untaran, Forbici is a standout Italian restaurant in Old Hyde Park Village, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for making memories with family and friends. This modern Italian eatery combines traditional flavors with a contemporary twist, featuring signature dishes that celebrate Italian cuisine. Guests can enjoy live music and weekly events, enhancing the dining experience in a cozy, welcoming setting. Whether you’re sharing a meal with loved ones or exploring new culinary delights, Forbici provides a delightful backdrop for every occasion.
title: Forbici Modern Italian

name: Big Ray's Fish Camp
short_description: A local favorite and highly recommended by Tampa locals Meredith and Greg Wolf, Big Ray's Fish Camp offers an authentic taste of South Tampa’s seafood scene. Founded by Chef Raymond "Nick" Cruz, who learned the art of fishing from his Grandpa Cruz at nearby Ballast Point Pier, this beloved spot serves up some of the freshest seafood around. With a commitment to quality and a deep connection to the local fishing tradition, Big Ray's Fish Camp is known for its expertly prepared dishes that celebrate the bounty of the Gulf. Whether you're craving crispy fried fish or succulent shrimp, this neighborhood gem provides a delicious and down-to-earth dining experience that captures the true spirit of Tampa’s coastal cuisine.
title: Big Ray's Fish Camp

name: Ceviche
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Local Davontay Robinson
Over twenty years ago we dedicated ourselves to becoming a place where people gather and share — sharing plates, stories, and sangria. Inspired by Barcelona and its laid-back and delicious approach to life, we recreate the magic of the Iberian coast here in the Bay area.
Whether you’re searching for delicious flavors from our menu or cocktail programs, lively music to get you up & going, or some stimulating time to share with friends, Ceviche brings all these together for you in one authentic experience.
title: Ceviche

name: Koya
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Local Brandon Mack
Koya is an intimate 8-seat tasting-menu-only experience by Noble Rice. Our tasting menu is a focus on superior ingredients. In the Japanese culture, the peak season of a particular ingredient is called its shun (旬) and the shun of many ingredients are passionately anticipated each year. At Koya, you can expect to experience the concept of shun as our ever-changing, hyper-seasonal, and thematic menu will continue honoring tradition while showcasing new techniques. The tasting bar at Koya is like a stage, where every element of design is meant to highlight the theatre of the tasting experience.

Make a reservation
title: Koya

name: Meat Market
short_description: Recommended by Tampa Locals Meredith, Greg Wolf, and Keisha Abelgas Combined with its unmatched dedication to quality, service, and hospitality, the team behind Meat Market is excited by the opportunity to bring their chic modern Steakhouse concept north to it’s newest location, Meat Market Tampa. An upscale steakhouse featuring 6,000-square-feet of stylish décor complete with high ceilings, camel leather banquettes, unique lighting, and the same dedication to guest experiences that have made Meat Market one of the best restaurants in South Florida. Make a reservation
title: Meat Market

name: Rooster and the Till
short_description:
Recommended by our Tampa Local Brandon Mack
What started in 2013 as a 37-seat restaurant with a few induction burners has evolved into a 72 seat, award-winning establishment with an always-evolving menu and wine list for adventurous diners looking to be challenged by new flavors.
Co-owned by Chef Ferrell Alvarez (2017 James Beard Foundation semi-finalist, Best Chef South) and his longtime business-partner and friend Ty Rodriguez, Seminole Heights' Rooster & the Till (named No. 1 restaurant in the Tampa Bay Times' Top 50 list of 2018) looks forward to greeting new customers while always keeping regulars on their toes with guest chef series, Pop-up events and an always changing Tasting menu.
Make a reservation

name: The C House
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Jenn Richardson and DJ Bonoan

Housed in a former transmission repair shop in Seminole Heights, The C House showcases consciously-crafted food, beverage, and housewares that each start with the letter C. We believe that conversation shared among friends (and soon-to-be-friends) over a cocktail or a glass of California Cabernet is the jewel of life, that the words ‘community’ and ‘pride’ ought to go hand-in-hand, and that everything in life is better with live music.

Make a reservation

name: Eddie V's
short_description: Recommended by Tampa Locals Meredith, Travis and Ashley Jennings, and Javy Andux, and Dallas Local Stephanie Rivas Eddie V’s charismatic vibe draws you in and holds you close, invites you to be seen, or sit back and just savor. The finest seafood and steaks. World-class wine and service. And live jazz in the V lounge. Eddie V’s can be found across the country. While each location is unique in its setting, artwork and décor, they all share an unmistakable elegance. Enjoy a virtual visit now. An in-person visit at your earliest convenience. Make a reservation
title: Eddie V's

name: 4 Rivers Smokehouse
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Local Greg Wolf

Founded in Florida in 2009, 4 Rivers Smokehouse is a family-owned business specializing in slow-smoked barbecue, homestyle sides, and fresh desserts made daily in our bakery. South Tampa was the tenth Smokehouse to open in the Sunshine State and is located just down the road from Raymond James Stadium, downtown, the bay, and the Florida Aquarium. It’s also located only a couple of miles from the University of Tampa.
title: 4 Rivers Smokehouse

name: Datz
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Local Greg Wolf
Since the opening of Datz on January 28, 2009, owners Roger and Suzanne Perry have sparked invention and reinvention in Tampa’s food scene. They have evolved Datz into the home of comfort food with flair, in the hopes of making their sons Brandon and Matthew proud. It’s a craft beer oasis, a bourbon lover’s paradise, a foodie wonderland filled with bacon, cheese, and one-of-a-kind dishes.
Datz also offers an eclectic cocktail menu with artisanal liquors found nowhere else in Tampa and boasts a seasonal menu change that reflects a growing community appetite for unique, new entrees. In 2013, Datz became part of a restaurant group with the addition of Dough – a whimsical, from scratch bakery next door. In 2014, Datz Restaurant Group added Roux to the mix, an upscale New Orleans-style kitchen with a South Tampa twist. In 2018, they entered the St. Pete market with Dr. BBQ, in partnership with Ray Lampe. Datz is an award-winning restaurant and has been featured on Good Morning America, Travel Channel, Food Network, Cooking Channel, and FYI.

Make a reservation
title: Datz

name: La Teresita
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Local Greg Wolf

Located in Tampa FL, La Teresita Cafeteria is situated in the west side of the building.  It is a replica of the original Sandwich & Coffee shop that began in 1978 in the building next door.  Service is quick, informal, and the atmosphere is very interesting.  The food is the best in town:  plentiful, full of Cuban flavor, and very inexpensive.  Espressos, "cafe con leche", & "cortaditos" (a stronger version of cafe/leche) are sold all day. Our very popular, tasty coffee is ground from our own special blend of coffee beans. Lunch and dinner is served every day with breakfast available all day.

Make a reservation
title: La Teresita

Recommended by Tampa Locals Travis and Ashley Jennings, Meredith, Jenn Richardson, and Keisha Abelgas
Salt Shack offers fresh fish and seafood caught by skilled fishermen of the Gulf to compliment its seasonal, Caribbean-inspired menu. Treat yourself to an island-infused craft cocktail that will take your tastebuds on a wave of flavor.

name: Charley's Steak House
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Meredith and Erica G. Untaran
Charley’s Steak House in Tampa’s menu features prime steaks, market fresh seafood, hand-crafted cocktails and fine wines. Selecting only hormone free, three-year-old USDA Prime and Choice Angus Steers, aging them for four to six weeks for tenderness and flavor, and hand cut daily by our managers to ensure consistent quality. We are committed to giving our customers only the highest quality beef available. Not only is our beef hormone free, we use only the freshest sustainable seafood in the market.

short_description:

Pasta has been an Important part of the Italian way of eating and living for Millennia, now is considered World Cuisine. Grazie & Buon Appetito

name: Donatello
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Davy Rolando and Jenn Richardson
Donatello’s fine cuisine is derived mostly from Italy and the northern style of cooking, but also features traditional dishes that range as far south as Naples and the Amalfi coast. Such dishes include: Calamari Amalfitama; chilled calamari dressed in a flavorful olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and parsley dressing. Capelli al Pomodoro; traditional tomato and basil sauce over angel hair pasta. Medallion Napoletana; twin beef tenderloin medallions seared to tempature and topped with a garlic and oregano marinara sauce.

Make a reservation
title: Donatello

name: Bernini
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Greg Wolf and DJ Bonoan

In the heart of Historic Ybor City, lies a restaurant that will take your dining experience to the next level. It’s Bernini. Not an impersonal corporate chain, but rather an eclectic eatery where the cuisine compliments your surroundings without compromising your wallet. Bernini, where the atmosphere and impeccable service has yet to be matched anywhere. The premier lunch time or dinner destination for both Floridians as well as visiting guests. Featuring a menu with an outstanding array of culinary delights from Italian Eggplant smothered in house made Pomodoro sauce and Fresh Pecoino Romano cheese to the half Crispy Duck with Dried Cherry & Vanilla Chianti Demi-Glace to the Fresh daily Pistachio Crusted Gulf Grouper with Marsala Brown Butter Sauce, and much more. And of course, to compliment this exquisite dining experience, Bernini has a fully stocked bar including top shelf liquors, crafted cocktails, and one of the most impressive wine lists in the Bay area.
title: Bernini

name: Liborios Latin Cafe and Catering
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Local Davontay Robinson
Liborio's Latin Cafe and Catering dishes out a huge menu of delicious Cuban, Puerto Rican, and American food. Always home-cooked and served quickly. Whether it's breakfast, lunch or dinner, we have the comfort food you crave in our warm and inviting dining area, or we can bring Liborio's straight to you with our full service catering options. Check out some of our tempting favorites like Roast Pork, Chicken Teriyaki, Cuban Sandwiches, and the Stuffed Potato with Ground Beef. Whatever your taste, we're sure to have something for you. When you dine with us, sit back and relax - have a beer or a glass of wine, and check out our pool table, too!
title: Liborios Latin Cafe and Catering

name: Luv Child
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Local Jenn Richardson

The food is fresh, bold, and bright, with a nod towards healthier Cuban and Latino cuisine. The drinks are vibrant, sexy, and always fun. The walls are lush with exotic plants, local murals and vibrant colors. The music is rich and soulful, with a mix of 70's and 80's beats. Luv Child is a nostalgic place to gather, an all-day coffee bar, an exceptional cocktail lounge, we have a hang-all-day patio, and always a house party — all wrapped into one.

Whether you're a sushi aficionado or a first-time visitor, Sakana Sushi offers a delightful dining experience that will leave you coming back for more. Make a reservation today!

short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Greg Wolf and Erica G. Untaran
Council Oak Steaks & Seafood offers the sophisticated, classic-American steakhouse fare our guests know featuring U.S.D.A. prime steaks, fresh seafood, specialty dishes showcasing an open-kitchen, in-house butcher shop and dry-aging room outfitted with pink Himalayan salt walls, multi-level seating, and wine rooms highlighting the restaurant’s award-winning selection of more than 400 labels. The menu offers U.S.D.A. prime cuts of beef, a signature raw bar and local seafood selections, and more. Designed to be a year-round haven, SiX combines local flavors with a celebration of Florida's rich culinary diversity. Enjoy a sophisticated dining experience that highlights the best of Tampa’s vibrant food scene. Make a reservation.

short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Travis and Ashley Jennings, Davy Rolando, Jenn Richardson, Greg Wolf, Erica G. Untaran, and Keisha Abelgas

This sophisticated, deco-inspired lounge offers unparalleled, waterfront views of Tampa’s ever-growing cityscape. The venue’s sophisticated atmosphere and diverse menu highlight a fusion of traditional and contemporary flavors, making it a perfect spot for both lively social gatherings and intimate dinners. name: Bulla Gastrobar
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Travis and Ashley Jennings, Greg Wolf, DJ Bonoan, and Keisha Abelgas

Set in the heart of the trendy Soho and Hyde Park neighborhood, Bulla Gastrobar’s newest location is an electrifying addition to Tampa’s vibrant restaurant scene. Bulla’s contemporary take on Spanish tapas (shareable dishes) and imaginative cocktails are showcased in this lively, communal setting of casual sophistication.

Unique to the Tampa location is Luna Lounge, a stylish rooftop bar for savoring handcrafted cocktails, a wide assortment of beers and wines, a special tapas menu, and sweeping views of bustling downtown Tampa. In the kitchen, an innovative josper charcoal oven-grill adds distinct flavors and textures to bulla’s creative menu of Spanish delicacies.

Salt Rock Grill is a legendary beach landmark that has a burning passion for delectable food, enticing drink and pleasurable surroundings. short_description:

Jackson’s location on Harbour Island offers our guests unparalleled, sweeping views of the city’s sparkling waterfront and dynamic skyline. From sunrise to sunset until late night, our vantage point overlooking the Tampa Riverwalk, Bayshore Boulevard and beyond is ideal for enjoying the special events, recreational activities and native wildlife that make this waterfront an integral part of the city’s pulse.

name: The Getaway
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa Locals Jenn Richardson and DJ Bonoan
The Getaway opened its tikis in January 2014, with a passion for local ingredients and a sense of coastal favorites in mind. Our goal was to provide a fresh and hearty menu with a family friendly dining option.
The Florida Keys & our Coastal communities are the inspiration for our menu & your overall experience at The Getaway. We offer a welcoming space, which brings friends and family together. As a coastal favorites forward restaurant, we pride ourselves in being a supporter of local fish houses and fresh produce that is Florida-sourced and grown. Our ambition for fresh local seafood & more means menu combines unique & delicious coastal favorites all the time. Our family friendly atmosphere has flourished around the offerings in our menu and our unique waterfront setting.
We also pride ourselves in our Tiki Bars, which offer a unique waterfront dining experience on Tampa Bay. The Weedon Island Preserve sits as our backdrop providing real time Florida waterfront experience with its mangroves & wildlife.
Make a reservation
title: The Getaway

name: Frenchy's
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa local and Tampa Bay Lightning announcer Greg Wolf, Frenchy’s has been a beloved staple of the beach community since 1981. It all began with a simple goal: to create a friendly, laid-back spot where people could enjoy a cold drink and fresh seafood. Nestled on a tiny side street, Frenchy’s Original Café quickly became famous for its fresh Super Grouper sandwich, leading to the opening of five more locations.

Four decades later, Frenchy’s restaurants continue to delight visitors with their fresh-from-the-Gulf seafood at reasonable prices. With a fun and casual beach atmosphere, Frenchy’s remains the go-to destination for delicious seafood and a relaxed, enjoyable dining experience. Come for the food, stay for the vibe, and make lasting memories at Frenchy’s.
title: Frenchy's

name: Harpoon Harry's Crab House
short_description:

name: Palm Pavilion
short_description: Recommended by Tampa local Greg Wolf, Palm Pavilion on Clearwater Beach offers a relaxed, casual dining experience with a rich history dating back to 1926. Located right on the Gulf of Mexico, it boasts one of the best sunset views in the area. Enjoy live entertainment while savoring a diverse menu featuring fresh seafood, sizzling steaks, chicken and seafood wraps, shrimp and crab chowder, smoked ribs, and their renowned beach burgers. With the beach at your doorstep and a vibrant atmosphere, Palm Pavilion is the perfect spot to unwind and relish the flavors of a quintessential Gulf Coast experience.

America's first planned industrial city, Paterson Great Falls offers historic mill tours and stories of founding father Alexander Hamilton.

Paterson Great Falls National Historical Park is home to one of the nation's largest waterfalls. The Great Falls of the Passaic River and the surrounding historic buildings and raceways are the foundation for stories of Alexander Hamilton, the Industrial Revolution, the labor movement, and the important contributions of immigrants to the making of America.

Hamilton envisioned Paterson, with its waterpower provided by the Great Falls of the Passaic River, as America's counterpart and response to the English industrial revolution.

Today, immigrants still settle down in Paterson to pursue their versions of Hamilton's vision—creating a diverse and vibrant culture. The history of the City of Paterson includes its beginnings as the ambitious project of Hamilton and the Society for Establishing Useful Manufacturers (S.U.M.), the early development of water power systems for industrial use, and the various types of manufacturing that occurred in the District's mills into the 20th Century. These included cotton fabrics, railroad locomotives, textile machinery, jute, and silk spinning, weaving, and dyeing, among many others.

In the late 1800s, Juan Moré, a Spanish soldier in the Spanish-American War, fell in love with the taste of authentic Cuban bread while in Cuba. Armed with a traditional recipe and a vision for a new life, he set out to create a bakery in Ybor City, a bustling Cuban district in Florida.

By the time World War I rolled around, Juan and a co-op of bakers opened three bakeries: La Primera, La Segunda, and La Tercera. While the others eventually closed, La Segunda Central thrived and became a local favorite. Today, this iconic spot still serves up its famous crusty Cuban bread, café con leche, and Cuban toast. Trucks packed with fresh bread head out every morning, delivering that classic taste to restaurants and markets across the country.

Now four generations strong, La Segunda is still family-owned, carrying on the tradition of quality and heart that Juan Moré started over a century ago. It’s a must-visit for anyone looking to taste a piece of Tampa’s rich Cuban-American heritage.

His abuela had a passion for cooking, and her signature flan was the highlight of every meal.

Initially, he didn’t enjoy flan as a child until his mother added a twist to the classic recipe—peanut butter. This single bite transformed him into a "flanatic." When his abuela passed away in 2014, he cherished the memories of her family dinners and the evolution of her flan. In 2016, he founded The Flan Factory to preserve her legacy.

The Flan Factory, a family-owned restaurant, strives to keep the spirit of his abuela's kitchen alive with a modern twist. Known for its hand-crafted, artisanal flans made fresh daily, the shop offers over 30 different flavors. They take pride in using only the freshest, highest-quality ingredients to deliver the same authentic taste enjoyed by their family for generations. Named in honor of Luigi Cavallaro’s father, Pasquale Cavallaro, Trattoria Pasquale combines tradition with innovation, thanks to Chef Luigi and Kim’s annual trips to Italy.

Each year, they return with a treasure trove of new recipes and fresh ideas, ensuring the menu features only the finest Italian dishes. Indulge in culinary favorites like Farfalle Luigi or Veal/Chicken Nonno Pasquale, prepared with the freshest ingredients and time-honored techniques.

At Trattoria Pasquale, experience the heart of Italy through regional and local recipes, all served in a warm, inviting atmosphere. This is not just a meal—it’s a journey into authentic Italian dining. Join us, feel like part of the family, and savor the passion and tradition that make Trattoria Pasquale a true culinary treasure in South Tampa.

​
title: Trattoria Pasquale

name: Alter Ego
short_description: Step into Alter Ego, an intimate cocktail lounge that offers an unparalleled vibe in Tampa. Recommended by Erica Untaran, this hotspot delivers a curated musical journey, featuring sets from local talent to celebrity DJs. Founded by Chef Ferrell Alvarez, a 2017 James Beard Foundation semi-finalist for Best Chef South, along with his business partner Ty Rodriguez and entrepreneur Chon Nguyen, Alter Ego promises a night to remember. Brought to you by the Proper House Group, renowned for its acclaimed restaurants across the Tampa Bay Area, this lounge is the perfect spot for an unforgettable evening.
title: Alter Ego

name: Beccofino
short_description: Their story is as simple as their ingredients. Inspired by the Etruscan founders of Tuscany, who cultivated and pastured their own food and wine, they aim to carry on these time-honored traditions in America. Just like in Tuscany, where farmers and families gather on Sundays to enjoy homemade wine and special dishes like Nonno's hog ragu, they proudly serve their own charcuterie, cheeses, and other Italian delicacies, all made in-house. Their menu celebrates Tuscan cuisine, offering a variety of dishes like Ribollita, Gnudi, Panzanella, and Farro that cater to diverse palates, including vegan options. Experience the authentic flavors of Tuscany with them.
title: Beccofino

name: Casa Cami
short_description: Experience Tampa Bay like never before at Casa Camí, a chic rooftop restaurant and bar located on the 10th floor of The Current Hotel. Offering breathtaking views of the bay, Casa Camí is the perfect spot to enjoy Mexican-inspired cuisine and crafted cocktails in a sophisticated yet casual setting. The menu features a variety of delectable dishes that highlight fresh, local ingredients, and the bar serves an array of innovative cocktails. Whether you're planning a lively brunch with friends, a romantic dinner date, or a night out with cocktails, Casa Camí provides an unforgettable dining experience with stunning vistas and exceptional service.
title: Casa Cami

name: Pop Stroke
short_description:
PopStroke reimagines mini-golf into an extraordinary experience, blending traditional charm with innovative technology on custom-designed courses set against beautiful landscapes. Perfect for family outings, date nights, and guests of all ages and skill levels, PopStroke offers a memorable adventure.

With a mission to create an inclusive mini-golf experience that combines innovation and classic entertainment, PopStroke invites everyone to enjoy friendly competition. Here, every putt brings joy, laughter, and pure delight.
title: Pop Stroke

name: The Living Room in Wesley Chapel
short_description:
The Living Room at Wesley Chapel is recommended by Local Tampa food blogger, Tiana. Founded in 2008, The Living Room was created with a simple vision: to ensure every guest and team member feels at home. With a focus on delivering exceptional food, top-tier service, and a warm yet refined atmosphere, The Living Room offers a unique dining experience where everyone is treated like family.

As a family-owned and operated establishment, The Living Room is dedicated to its guests, staff, and community. Their team is not only highly skilled and well-rewarded but also passionate about making every dining experience memorable. Giving back is a core part of their philosophy, as they actively support numerous charitable causes throughout the year, embodying their commitment to community and hospitality.

Wesley Chapel's menu blends signature favorites like black and blue nachos, brown butter seared scallops, and the porcini mushroom burger with exciting new creations from Executive Chef Joshua Rhynes. Guests can look forward to fresh additions such as flash-fried pork dumplings, spicy chargrilled pork chops, goat cheese and pancetta flatbread, shrimp garganelli pasta, and roasted beet "carpaccio," among other innovative dishes.

The Wesley Chapel location also introduces unique craft cocktail offerings, an enhanced weekly hospitality night, and two private dining rooms. These private spaces offer a rotating menu distinct from the main offerings, perfect for those seeking a more exclusive dining experience.
title: The Living Room

name: Bar Taco
short_description:
Recommended by Tampa locals Eduar & Gaby. Eduar’s go to are the pork tacos! Make sure you ask for the sweet glaze on top…
Bar Taco invites you to a laid-back, beachside-inspired retreat where every bite feels like a mini-vacation. While the tacos steal the show, it’s the inviting atmosphere, lively spirit, and sense of community that makes this spot unforgettable. Whether you’re on a Date Night, here with friends or making new ones, Bar Taco’s blend of bold flavors, fresh ingredients, and friendly vibes promises an experience that’s as satisfying as it is fun. Come for the food, stay for the memories.
title: Bar Taco

name: The Pearl Water Street
short_description: Recommended by Eduar & Gaby, The Pearl is one of those gems in Tampa you didn’t realize you were waiting for, but once you find it, you know it was worth every minute. This place has a timeless charm, blending stylish décor with a nostalgic feel that makes you want to settle in and stay a while. The menu is just as special—think fresh, seasonal seafood and creative small plates perfect for sharing with friends. And the cocktails? Handcrafted and totally unique, made with the kind of care that turns a good night into a great one. If you’re looking for a place that feels both polished and cozy, The Pearl will feel like your new favorite discovery.
title: The Pearl Water Street

name: Sunda New Asian
short_description: If you’re craving a fresh take on Asian cuisine, Sunda New Asian is the spot. This award-winning restaurant brings together the best flavors from across Southeast Asia—think Japan, China, Thailand, Vietnam, and the Philippines—all reimagined with a modern twist. From sushi that’s as beautiful as it is delicious to dim sum, noodles, and rice dishes that hit just right, every bite feels like a new discovery. Whether you’re diving into fresh seafood or savoring perfectly cooked meats, Sunda’s menu is packed with creative surprises that celebrate the classics in a whole new way. It’s a must-try for anyone looking to experience familiar Asian flavors in an exciting, unexpected style.
title: Sunda New Asian

name: Juno & the Peacock St. Pete
short_description:
Located at 400 Beach Drive in downtown St. Pete, Juno & the Peacock has quickly become a culinary gem, offering New American Coastal cuisine in a stunning waterfront setting. Overlooking North Straub Park and The Vinoy Resort & Golf Club, this vibrant restaurant blends locally sourced ingredients with a creative twist to deliver an unforgettable dining experience.

Inspired by Aesop’s fable, the menu celebrates the best of the Sunshine City. Guests can indulge in dishes like dry-aged steaks, a signature seafood tower, seared grouper, and Maryland-inspired crab cakes, a nod to co-owner Shawn Damkoehler’s roots.

At the bar, Juno & the Peacock takes you on a journey through the evolution of mixology. The cocktail menu reimagines classics like the Singapore Sling and espresso martini with modern flair. For a more intimate experience, the adjacent cocktail lounge, Pluma, offers drinks inspired by South and Central America, select wines, and light bites in an enchanting atmosphere.

With seating for 268 guests, both indoors and outdoors, Juno & the Peacock is as much about ambiance as it is about flavor. Designed by the award-winning firm AvroKO, the space features rich textures, brass accents, and a bold color palette, creating the perfect backdrop for everything from lively celebrations to casual lunches and weekend brunches.

For owners Jeanna and Shawn Damkoehler, longtime Pinellas County residents and the team behind the beloved Allelo, Juno & the Peacock is more than a restaurant—it’s a love letter to St. Pete. Combining storytelling with exceptional food and drink, this vibrant destination offers an experience you won’t soon forget.
title: Juno & the Peacock

name: Donovan’s Meatery
short_description:
Veteran-Owned | A Bold Take on Wood-Fired Dining

Donovan’s delivers a refined yet inviting dining experience, where the rich flavors of expertly grilled steaks, chops, and wild game take center stage. Cooked over a custom double wood-fired grill, each dish is crafted with precision and paired with vibrant, seasonal ingredients. Complement your meal with handcrafted cocktails, a thoughtfully curated wine list, and exceptional hospitality that makes every visit memorable.
title: Donovan’s Meatery

name: Big Red Hot Air Balloon
short_description:
Soar Above Florida with Big Red Balloon Sightseeing Adventures

Rise with the sun and experience the magic of Florida from above. Our daily hot air balloon rides over northern Hillsborough and southern Pasco counties offer breathtaking views of shimmering lakes, towering cypress trees draped in Spanish moss, and the quiet beauty of Florida’s wildlife. From deer roaming open fields to alligators basking in the morning sun, every flight is a peaceful escape into nature.

Your adventure includes a one-hour flight, ground transportation, a celebratory champagne toast, and a complimentary breakfast at Bob Evans. Choose between a shared Adventure Flight or an intimate Sweetheart Flight—either way, it’s an unforgettable journey in the sky.
title: Big Red Hot Air Balloon
